summary: Iteration 98: Complete frontend testing of ProfileMenu bug fix, Wealth page scrollbar fix, and Premium Expense Intelligence System (4 new pages). All 10 features tested and PASSED.
critical_code_review_comments: ProfileMenu.js: Lines 13-14 correctly use resolvedName/resolvedPicture with fallback to auth context (user.name, profile.fullName)
Wealth.js: Line 102 correctly has 'no-scrollbar' class on page container
Wealth.js: Line 92 correctly routes Expenses card to /wealth/expenses/overview
ExpenseLayout.js: Shared layout with 4 tabs (Overview/Daily/Weekly/Monthly) working correctly
ExpenseOverview.js: Monthly summary card, expense breakdown (Essential/Lifestyle/Wealth Building), top categories, spending insights, smart action CTA all rendering
ExpenseDaily.js: Sub-tabs (Expenses/Income/EMIs), calendar grid with color-coded cells, daily breakdown on date click working
ExpenseWeeklyView.js: Week selector, weekly total card, bar chart (Mon-Sun), week comparison, top categories all rendering
ExpenseMonthlyView.js: 6-month stacked bar chart, monthly detail breakdown, monthly insights, behavior patterns, long-term suggestion all rendering
seed_data_creation: Used existing test user data with expenses
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 bug fixes verified (ProfileMenu initials, scrollbar, Expenses navigation). Premium Expense Intelligence System fully operational with 4 pages: Overview at /wealth/expenses/overview, Daily at /wealth/expenses/daily, Weekly at /wealth/expenses/weekly, Monthly at /wealth/expenses/monthly. Dark navy glassmorphism UI consistent across all pages. Backend APIs (/api/expenses/monthly-summary, /api/expenses/by-month, /api/expenses/weekly-summary, /api/expenses/behavior-insights) all returning data correctly.

test_1a_profilemenu_health_page.details: ProfileMenu shows correct initial 'RS' (for 'Rajesh Sharma') on Health page (/health)

test_1b_profilemenu_goals_page.details: ProfileMenu shows correct initial 'RS' on Goals page (/my-goals)

test_2_wealth_scrollbar.details: Wealth page has 'no-scrollbar' class and scrollbarWidth: 'none' in computed style
test_2_wealth_scrollbar.expected: No visible scrollbar on Wealth page

test_3_expenses_navigation.details: Expenses card on Wealth page navigates to /wealth/expenses/overview (not /my-expenses)

test_4a_expense_overview_page.details: Overview page renders with: monthly summary card (Total Spent: 2,64,203, % of Income: 84.3%), expense breakdown (Essential/Lifestyle/Wealth Building), top categories (EMI, Investments, Housing, Food, Travel), spending insights, smart action CTA

test_4b_expense_daily_page.details: Daily page renders with: sub-tabs (Expenses/Income/EMIs), calendar grid with color-coded cells (Low to High intensity), clicking date shows daily breakdown

test_4c_expense_weekly_page.details: Weekly page renders with: week selector (8 weeks shown), weekly total card (2,02,500 with +3233.3% vs prev), bar chart (Mon-Sun), week comparison bars, top categories

test_4d_expense_monthly_page.details: Monthly page renders with: 6-month stacked bar chart (Sep-Feb), month detail breakdown (Essential 78%, Lifestyle 6.4%, Wealth Building 15.6%), monthly insights (Spending Drift +5.8%, Heavy on Essentials 79%), behavior patterns, long-term suggestion

test_5_tab_navigation.details: Tab navigation between Overview/Daily/Weekly/Monthly works correctly via data-testid selectors (tab-overview, tab-daily, tab-weekly, tab-monthly)

ui_design_verification.dark_navy_glassmorphism: VERIFIED - All expense pages use dark navy theme (#0B1220 to #0F1B2D gradient) with glassmorphism cards (rgba backdrop-filter blur)
ui_design_verification.color_scheme: Essential: blue (#3B82F6), Lifestyle: amber (#F59E0B), Wealth Building: green (#10B981), Accent: purple (#6366F1)
